name: Terra Quantum
description: Terra Quantum is a Swiss quantum technology company developing a hybrid quantum-classical computing platform for enterprise applications. The company combines quantum algorithms with classical computing infrastructure to deliver practical quantum solutions for optimization, machine learning, and cryptography challenges.

products.name: TQ42 Platform
products.description: Hybrid quantum-classical computing platform delivering optimization, machine learning, and cryptography solutions for enterprise

highlights: Over $85M in funding for hybrid quantum-classical enterprise solutions

Serves enterprise clients in optimization, machine learning, and security

news.title: Terra Quantum announces 40,000km quantum cryptography breakthrough
news.excerpt: Terra Quantum, the Swiss quantum technology company, is announcing a breakthrough in quantum cryptography with a technology that allows quantum cryptography keys to be transmitted over a distance of more than 40,000km.

news.title: Terra Quantum and Axiom Intelligence announce $3.5B SPAC merger to list on Nasdaq
news.excerpt: Terra Quantum and Axiom Intelligence Acquisition Corp. 1 announced a definitive business combination agreement valuing Terra Quantum at $3.5 billion, with the combined company expected to list on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol TQ.

news.title: Terra Quantum and Apex.AI Demonstrate NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography for Cloud-Connected Robotic Systems
news.excerpt: Terra Quantum and Apex.AI demonstrated successful integration of NIST-standardized post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM/CRYSTALS-Kyber) into an Apex.AI robotic software environment for secure edge-to-cloud communication, targeting robotics, automotive, defense, and critical infrastructure.
